note: This tree serialized to ~49k chars at detail "full" — beyond what a tool result can deliver, so this is the same tree with its LAYOUT intact and its APPEARANCE dropped. Every frame still carries its exact layout (flex/grid mode, padding, itemSpacing/gap, alignment) and each node its sizing and constraints, and each text its characters. What is missing is colour, typography, effects and token bindings. Build the structure from the layout objects, never from x/y: emit the container and its gap/padding, not per-child margins or absolute offsets. To get what is missing, call get_design_context per section nodeId (detail: full, dedupeComponents: true) before building that section — never estimate those values from a screenshot.
